# Independent perspective references

Generated by `scripts/generate-projective-fixtures.py` using NumPy linear solving,
an independent half-plane line-arrangement polygon intersection, polygon moments,
and SciPy float64 premultiplied bilinear interpolation. No editor code or WASM is
used by the generator. The deterministic synthetic float32 source retains signed
and extended colors, partial alpha and hidden RGB at zero alpha.

`manifest.json` records native geometry, exact authored corners, output windows,
raw sample hashes and the fixed scaled float32 gate. Compressed float files are
little-endian RGBA. `large-placement` uses a remote world origin without changing
source geometry. `minified` exercises partial-pixel support and
`pixel-corner-contacts` exercises duplicate clipped boundary vertices.

These are synthetic engine references, not photographic or full editor-tool
acceptance. The real 50 MP browser/source checks use the existing independent
native-CMM uint16 corpus separately, with streamed reference readback.
